hints.title: Monotonic Capability
hints.text: If a maximum capability C allows robbing at least k non-adjacent houses, any larger capability also allows it.

hints.title: Greedy Feasibility Check
hints.text: To test capability C, iterate through houses. Whenever nums[i] <= C, rob house i and skip house i + 1.

hints.title: Bisection Search over Capability
hints.text: Binary search over the answer range [min(nums), max(nums)] to find the minimal feasible capability.

hints.title: Binary Search on Capability Implementation

variables: max, min: extreme values in nums
complexity.notes: Binary search on monotonic capability with O(n) greedy validation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard DP without binary search takes O(n * k) which is too slow for n, k = 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inverts minimization of maximum capability into binary search with greedy non-adjacent count check.
